From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Pipe gap pulse: BrightOps coverage snapshot + asks

Team / Elaine —

Quick pulse here ahead of Friday's commit. Attached is a lightweight snapshot of the BrightOps pipeline (see pipe_snapshot_brightops_q3.csv) — I ran a coverage calc against our target ARR and flagged the top 6 opportunities that are not yet in Commit. Bottom line: we’re ~38% short of target coverage if nothing converts.

Asks (quick):
- Monica/karthik: can you confirm stage moves for the 6 flagged deals by EOD Thursday? I need yes/no for Advance to Commit / Keep Best Case / Drop.
- Lauren: please re-run the commit-weighted coverage using the MAP_proposal_v2.pdf numbers (pricing updates) and paste the updated coverage % in reply.
- Elaine / BrightOps: if you’re still planning a pilot, what is the procurement ETA? We want to know if we can count a pilot as a Commit signal for the quarter.

Notes: I’m marking any deal relying solely on a vendor discount approval as TBD — those shouldn’t be treated as Commit without a signed PO.

Attachments: pipe_snapshot_brightops_q3.csv, MAP_proposal_v2.pdf

Thanks — quick sync will keep forecast sane.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Revenue Operations

> Quick pulse here ahead of Friday's commit. Attached is a lightweight snapshot of the BrightOps pipeline...

Attached the CSV with a quick column called "recommended_action" — I flagged the six deals (rows 4,7,11,15,19,22). Summary here: 

- BOPS-004 (prod pilot) — Move to Commit. Customer agreed to pilot contract; procurement now needs PO (Elaine confirmed below).
- BOPS-007 (SaaS consolidation) — Keep Best Case. Exec sponsor still evaluating between two vendors; probability 60%.
- BOPS-011 (analytics add-on) — Drop to Best Case. Pricing gap; needs discount approval.
- BOPS-015 (expansion) — Move to Commit if PO arrives by Fri EOD.
- BOPS-019 (security review) — Keep Best Case. SOC2 evidence pending; estimated 3 weeks.
- BOPS-022 (replatform) — Move to Commit. Legal sign-off expected next week.

I attached pipe_snapshot_brightops_q3.csv. Quick ask for Lauren: the MAP_proposal_v2.pdf increases list price ~8% for the core module — that reduces required coverage marginally, but we'll need the updated coverage number to confirm.

—

Thanks Monica — and hi Rishi/Karthik/Lauren. Quick answers from BrightOps side:

- Pilot (BOPS-004): Procurement sprinted this morning. We are targeting a PO by next Wednesday (2028-09-28). I can loop in our legal and procurement contacts (copied) if that helps accelerate.
- Expansion (BOPS-015): internal finance wants to see final pricing; can you confirm the updated MAP?
- Timing note: we are comfortable with a three-month pilot but prefer not to mark it as an official Commit until PO is received. We can provide a signed letter of intent — would Redwood accept LOI + deposit as a partial commit signal?

Procurement contact: procurement@brightops.com

Thanks all — good progress. Finalize items below so I can lock the forecast before Friday's close: 

Action items (owners / deadlines):
- Monica: update CRM stage for the six flagged deals (Advance to Commit / Best Case / Drop) and add procurement notes by EOD today. (owner: monica_patel)
- Karthik: if any deal moves to Commit with LOI + deposit, please add the LOI as an attachment and set probability to 75%; if PO confirmed then 100%. Update deal records by 10:00 AM PT Monday. (owner: karthik_iyer)
- Lauren: rerun coverage using MAP_proposal_v2.pdf pricing and paste the new coverage percentage in a reply to this thread. Need this by EOD today. (owner: lauren_bishop)
- Elaine / BrightOps: if procurement can provide a dated LOI or an internal PO timeline, send to procurement@redwoodinference.com and cc rishi@redwoodinference.com — we will treat LOI+deposit as conditional Commit for the quarter planning exercise.

If we get the LOI + deposit signal for BOPS-004 and BOPS-015, my projection shows coverage moving from ~62% to ~87% (pending Lauren's pricing pull). If any of those fail to materialize, we will need to reallocate Closers into the deal slate next week.

Links: HubSpot record (deal): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/BRIGHTOPS-67
MAP folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAP-proposal

I'll run a final sweep Monday morning and send a short commit note to the finance mailbox. Appreciate the quick turn.
